goal: Disclose AI, get consent, qualify (purpose/budget/config/timeline), book a site visit, handle opt-out.
notes: This is the versioned source of truth for the conversation. The browser demo in web/assets/app.js mirrors it (English) for an offline preview. In production the caller-agent (WP-3) loads this flow as data and the LLM handles free-form turns; opt-out is enforced by the compliance-agent (WP-5), fail-closed.

backchannel.note: Spoken the instant the prospect stops talking, before the reply exists. A human makes a sound within about 200ms; 3-4 seconds of silence while the pipeline runs is what makes an agent feel like a machine. These carry no information and commit to nothing, which is why they can be said before the model has decided anything. Kept here rather than in code because they are words a prospect hears.

style.note: HOW SHE SHOULD SOUND, per language, shown to the model as house style rather than as lines to recite. The qualification questions are not duplicated per language — the model composes them — so without examples it defaults to textbook Telugu and Hindi. These are the register, not the script. AN EXAMPLE MAY CARRY REGISTER, NEVER A CLAIM. Two of these used to read 'possession is next March' — a possession date this agent has never been given, shown to the model as a worked example of stating a project fact from nowhere, on every single Telugu and Hindi call. They are now examples of the DEFERRAL instead, which is the behaviour we actually want when a fact is not in hand. scripts/test-voice.mjs asserts no example contains a digit or a month name; the whole class is caught rather than these two instances.

qualification._note: What a closer needs to know, and what each answer is worth. The reviewer LLM only puts each answer in a bucket; the score is computed in code from the weights below (api/_lib/scoring.js), so two identical calls always score identically and a closer can be shown exactly how the number was reached.

fields.label: Buying to live in, or to invest

dispositionCeiling._note: However well someone answered, the outcome caps the score. Somebody who opted out is not a warm lead because they told us their budget first.

steps.say: Namaste! This is Anaga, an AI assistant from Modcon Builders, calling about the Skyline Villaments project in Hyderabad. Just so you know, I'm an AI voice agent. Do you have a quick minute to talk?
Are you looking for a home to live in, or more as an investment?
What budget range are you considering — for example one to two crore, or higher?
Are you looking at a 2BHK, 3BHK, or something larger?
Are you planning to buy in the next few months, or just exploring for now?
Based on what you've told me, I think Skyline Villaments would suit you. Could I book you a site visit this weekend?
Would Saturday or Sunday work better for you?
Done! I've booked your site visit for {day}. You'll get a WhatsApp confirmation with the location, and our sales manager will meet you there. Thank you for your time!
No problem — I'll have our sales manager send the project details on WhatsApp, and we can arrange a visit whenever you're ready. Thank you!
No worries — I'll try you another time. Thank you, and have a good day!
I completely understand. I'm adding your number to our do-not-call list now, so you won't receive further calls. Apologies for the disturbance.

directions._note: How the call STARTED. Everything after the opening — the qualification questions, the scoring, the closing, the opt-out — is identical, and is deliberately NOT duplicated here: two copies of a qualification script drift, and the one that drifts is the one nobody is reading. Only the opening and the consent model differ, because only they actually do. {project} and {city} are substituted from `project` above so a greeting cannot name a development this flow is not selling. Every line is reviewed wording, never machine-translated — same rule as the disclosure in anaga.persona.json. SCRIPT: the Hindi and Telugu lines are in NATIVE SCRIPT, not Roman transliteration. Bulbul is asked to speak te-IN/hi-IN and was being handed Latin text, which it pronounces as transliterated English — the single loudest reason the voice sounded synthetic. The em dashes were replaced with commas for the same reason: they are read as an unnatural break. These are transcriptions of the same reviewed wording, not a rewrite, and still want a native speaker's ear before launch. REGISTER: the Telugu and Hindi lines are CODE-MIXED, which is what these calls actually sound like in Hyderabad — property vocabulary stays English (enquiry, time, budget, site visit, investment) inside a Telugu or Hindi sentence. Pure literary Telugu reads as a government notice being recited, which is the 'too Telugu-ish' complaint. The English words are written in NATIVE SCRIPT (ఎంక్వైరీ, టైమ్) rather than Latin, for the reason above: Bulbul mispronounces Latin text inside an Indic sentence.

outbound.label: We ring a lead who left their number on a Meta or Instagram ad

greet.en-IN: Hi, I'm Anaga, an AI voice assistant from Modcon Builders. You asked about {project} in {city} on Instagram — is now a good time to talk for two minutes?
greet.hi-IN: नमस्ते, मैं अनगा हूँ, मॉडकॉन बिल्डर्स की AI वॉइस असिस्टेंट। आपने इंस्टाग्राम पर {city} के {project} के बारे में एन्क्वायरी की थी ना। दो मिनट का टाइम है क्या?
greet.te-IN: హలో, నేను అనగా, మోడ్‌కాన్ బిల్డర్స్ నుంచి AI వాయిస్ అసిస్టెంట్‌ని. మీరు ఇన్‌స్టాగ్రామ్‌లో {city}లోని {project} గురించి ఎంక్వైరీ చేశారు కదా. రెండు నిమిషాలు టైమ్ ఉందా?

rules: They left their number on a Meta or Instagram ad for this project. SAY SO in the opening — that enquiry is the reason this call is permitted at all, and a stranger who cannot place you hangs up.
Get consent before ANY qualification question. If it is a bad time, offer to call back and end (disposition "busy").
You interrupted them. Be brief and be easy to say no to.

inbound.label: They ring us after seeing the ad

greet.en-IN: Thanks for calling Modcon Builders — I'm Anaga, an AI voice assistant. Are you calling about {project}?
greet.hi-IN: मॉडकॉन बिल्डर्स को कॉल करने के लिए थैंक यू। मैं अनगा हूँ, AI वॉइस असिस्टेंट। क्या आप {project} के बारे में कॉल कर रहे हैं?
greet.te-IN: మోడ్‌కాన్ బిల్డర్స్‌కి కాల్ చేసినందుకు థాంక్యూ. నేను అనగా, AI వాయిస్ అసిస్టెంట్‌ని. మీరు {project} గురించి కాల్ చేస్తున్నారా?

rules: THEY rang YOU. Do not ask permission to talk and do not apologise for calling — they started this, and asking 'is now a good time?' of someone who just dialled you sounds like a machine reading a script.

Disclose that you are an AI in the first sentence anyway. Disclosure is not consent: consent is about whether they want the call, disclosure is about what they are talking to, and only the first one is implied by their dialling.
Find out WHICH ad or project brought them before qualifying — they may be calling about something this flow is not selling.
An inbound caller is warmer than a cold lead. Do not re-sell them on interest they have already shown; get to the site visit sooner.
